# Search, understand, and build with video

TwelveLabs finds the exact moments in your videos and answers questions about what happens in it. Use Jockey from Claude, ChatGPT, or the Agents API. Or build with the Marengo and Pegasus models through the Models API.

## Jockey or Models?

Every path below follows the same four steps. Choose Jockey or Models, then choose how you want to use it. Not sure which to choose? See [Choose between Models and Agents](https://docs.twelvelabs.io/v1.3/docs/get-started/models-or-agents).

1. 1Set upAdd Jockey to Claude or ChatGPT, sign in, or create an API key
2. 2Add videosUpload your videos
3. 3Ask or runAsk a question or run a task
4. 4Read resultsCited moments, clips, text, or embeddings

Jockey

Ask questions across your videos and receive cited moments. Jockey plans its own steps.

Ready-made tasks for your videos, like highlight reels, agentic search, and organizing a video library.](https://docs.twelvelabs.io/v1.3/agents/recipes)

Check your videos in Connect

Claude and ChatGPT only show the chat. Connect shows what Jockey has stored: your knowledge stores, uploads, collections, usage, and billing. Sign in with the account you used to connect Jockey, then open a knowledge store to see your videos and usage.

[Open Connect](https://connect.twelvelabs.io/)
